mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ui_flows (id, name, description, app_id, platform, catalog, is_component, steps, enabled, created_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{description}, #{appId}, #{platform}, #{catalog}, #{isComponent}, #{steps}, #{enabled}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE ui_flows SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, app_id = #{appId}, platform = #{platform}, catalog = #{catalog}, is_component = #{isComponent}, steps = #{steps}, enabled = #{enabled}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
